title: Fix Puzzle 3D Stuck After Context Menu Suggestion
description: puzzle 3d: sometimes after clicking on a suggestion over context menu the 3d is kind of stuck (the vortex remains selected, the hover stays, but somehow the group selection still works. but when trying to open a context menu for a new vortex nothing happens. clicking on background also doesnt do anything)
summary:
Fixed Puzzle 3D getting stuck after context-menu suggestion clicks.

Root cause: acceptSuggestion only cleared suggestionMenu.open on full placement success, so a failed place left every split pane’s regular context menu gated shut (sibling pane had no dismiss UI). Hover/selection also stayed sticky; right-click could arm connect-drag without host pointer-up; stale wasMarqueeDragRef could no-op the next background click.

Fixes: always dismiss suggestion menu (+ clear hover) on accept; clear selection after successful one-shot place; clear hover on close; scope context-menu suppression to owning windowId; sibling-pane dismiss listeners; empty-click closes suggestions and consumes marquee suppress flag; cancel connect-arm on open/accept/close; primary-button-only vortex pointerDown. Also unblocked compile with IntroductionAdvance::Tool validation arm.

Verified: cargo accept_suggestion_ (3 ok), close_vortex_suggestions (2 ok), vitest worldSuggestionMenuOwnsWindow (1 ok).
